title: Temporal Context
description: Canonical temporal fields for a source fact or record (Architecture Baseline section 5). Represents field shape and basic per-field validity only. Cross-field temporal rules are Engine/domain logic and are NOT enforced by this schema: event_at < prediction_cutoff for facts describing not-yet-occurred events; source_available_at <= prediction_cutoff for Knowledge-Time Verified data; and which fields are contextually required (requested_at/received_at/ingested_at are required by the Architecture Baseline for FootCap-collected raw provider snapshots; prediction_cutoff is required wherever a prediction context exists). See packages/contracts/README.md.

event_at.description: When the underlying football event actually happened. Null when event time is not applicable to this fact.

requested_at.description: When FootCap sent a request to the provider. Required by the Architecture Baseline for FootCap-collected raw snapshots; optional in other uses of this shape.

received_at.description: When FootCap received the provider response. Required by the Architecture Baseline for FootCap-collected raw snapshots; optional in other uses of this shape.

ingested_at.description: When FootCap persisted the information. Required by the Architecture Baseline for FootCap-collected raw snapshots; optional in other uses of this shape.

source_available_at.description: Earliest availability instant FootCap can evidence for this fact. Must always be present as a field; null means UNKNOWN and is the only meaning of null for this field. A missing/omitted field is invalid, not an alternative way to express UNKNOWN (ADR-009 decision 12).

prediction_cutoff.description: The point-in-time boundary eligibility rules are evaluated against. Required by the Architecture Baseline wherever a prediction context exists; optional/null in this general shape when no prediction context applies (e.g. raw ingestion).

temporal_classification.description: EVENT_TIME_SAFE or KNOWLEDGE_TIME_VERIFIED. A persisted temporal record must always contain this field.
